title: TLS extensibility probes
claim: Modeled on draft-davidben-tls-grease-00. A method comprising: advertising randomly selected reserved cipher suite values in ClientHello.cipher_suites; failing the connection if the server selects a reserved cipher suite value; and returning a server certificate signature over a Merkle root with inclusion proofs for every ignored ClientHello value.

elements.question: Did anyone describe advertising randomly selected reserved cipher suite values in a TLS ClientHello to test tolerance of unknown values?

elements.element: Rejecting selection of reserved cipher suites
elements.question: Did anyone describe failing a TLS connection when the server selects a cipher suite value reserved for testing tolerance of unknown values?

elements.element: Signed Merkle receipts for ignored values
elements.question: Did anyone describe a TLS server returning a signature using its certificate key over a Merkle root, with inclusion proofs for every ignored ClientHello value?
